comments.note: assertSafeWpId does not reject control characters (newlines, NUL bytes) in the wpId. These pass through to join() and fail naturally at the filesystem level with Zod parse as a secondary barrier — no security bypass is possible in practice. An explicit check for /[\r\n\0]/ would be a defensive-in-depth improvement but is non-blocking.

assertSafeSlug and assertSafeWpId are structurally identical 3-line functions.
